properties.geometry_name: Great Black Swamp review candidate — Gordon 1966 / ODNR class 4
properties.source_dataset: Ohio DNR Original Natural Vegetation of Ohio; Robert B. Gordon (1966)
properties.historical_period: time of earliest land surveys; source published 1966
properties.derivation_method: Dissolve complete ODNR VEG_CDE=4 polygons whose representative points fall within Maumee HUC8s 04100003-04100009 or Cedar-Portage HUC8 04100010; no clipping, buffering, smoothing, tracing, or hand editing
properties.source_authority: official state digitization of a published historical vegetation interpretation
properties.confidence: medium for regional swamp-forest footprint; low for a named Great Black Swamp boundary
properties.boundary_uncertainty: high; vegetation boundaries at 1:500,000 are not a named-swamp survey
properties.class_uncertainty: medium; Elm-Ash class omits marsh, wet prairie, and bottomland types
properties.interstate_compatibility: not merged; Indiana and Michigan require class/scale/terms crosswalk
properties.human_review_status: HOLD — choose A/B/C/D before canonical adoption
properties.notes: Regional historical reference only; not for parcel, restoration-targeting, or fine-scale hydrology
